violations.why: irq_vine (higher priority) can preempt irq_shoal between its write of 0 and the check, setting -1, so the check can fail.
irq_crest or irq_kiln (higher priority) can preempt irq_vine between the write of -1 and the check, setting 0.
A higher-priority ISR (ermine, crest or kiln) can preempt irq_grove after fn_reef sets -1 and overwrite v_umbra via fn_jade before the check at line 60.
irq_grove (priority 3) can preempt irq_shoal (priority 2) between the two reads of v_ivory in fn_north and write it, so the reads see different values.
irq_grove can preempt irq_shoal between the two reads of v_marble in fn_north and write it, so the reads see different values.
irq_kiln (priority 6) can preempt irq_crest (priority 5) between its write of v_knoll[9000] and the later read, overwriting it with 999.
